messages.subject: reactive scatterplot3d
parts:
hello,
I'm a new shiny user.
I'm trying to build a reactive scatterplot3d but in my case it doesn't work, and I don't understand why.

There is my code:


form=reactive(function(){paste(sharedData$dataset$input$var,"~",paste(sharedData$dataset$input$x,collapse="*"),sep="")})
output$plan<-renderPlot({   
    if(length(input$x)>0){
    my.graph <- scatterplot3d(form(),type="h",pch=19)
    my.graph$plane3d(regression(),lty.box="solid")
    my.graph$points3d(regression()$fitted~form(),type="h",pch=19,col="red")
}   
    })



could any of you help me please ?

THANK YOU
